name: port-accept
summary: Accept a stable signal on input ports 0 and 1 (type 0x20; port 1 = DP input) after 30 x 20 ms = 0.6 s instead of 1.6 s

edits.asm: sub_260E0E ori r4,r0,0x50 -> ori r4,r0,0x1e (port +0x18 accept threshold for type 0x20)

notes: Port monitor sub_23B068 runs every 20 ms per port and accepts the signal after +0x18 stable passes (vendor 80 = 1.6 s for type 0x20). LG 28MQ780 firmware (same SDK) uses 30. A timing change during the window still sends the port back to state 1 (sub_23A7CB). No-signal threshold (400 passes) and other port types unchanged. Generated by tools/patches_src_port_accept.py (ACCEPT=n, 10-80).
